sequential_dependency.intermediate: Per-line lattice hit (marker position and color, or no hit) derived from marker_offset modulo spacing.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the common source edge and each seed-pair spacing; intersect marker offsets with that periodic lattice.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Choose each run color and stopping point from its hit, recolor both seeds and extend only periodic positions.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: An off-lattice control must be passed and preserved, while an on-lattice control recolors and stops the run; marker color alone cannot select the output.
